questions.prompt: What kind of music do you like to listen to?
questions.sampleA1: I like music. Pop music is good.
questions.sampleA2: I like music very much. I like pop music and sometimes rock music. Pop is happy, and I like to dance. But rock is good too, because it's strong.
questions.sampleB1: I like to listen to different kinds of music. I think pop music is my favorite. It's usually very upbeat and makes me feel good. For example, I really like songs by Taylor Swift. However, sometimes I also listen to classical music when I want to relax.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, my taste in music is all over the place, but I'd say I gravitate towards indie and a bit of R&B. I suppose it depends on my mood — something upbeat when I'm working out, and slower tracks to wind down in the evening. The thing is, the right song can completely turn my day around.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men musiqani juda yaxshi ko'raman. Men pop musiqani va ba'zan rok musiqani yaxshi ko'raman. Pop xursandchilik keltiradi, va men raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin rok ham yaxshi, chunki u kuchli.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men turli xil musiqalarni tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman. O'ylashimcha, pop musiqa mening eng sevimli turim. U odatda juda tetiklantiruvchi va meni yaxshi his qildiradi.
Masalan, menga Taylor Swiftning qo'shiqlari juda yoqadi. Biroq, ba'zida dam olishni xohlaganimda klassik musiqani ham tinglayman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men musiqa janrlarining ancha keng doirasini tinglashdan zavqlanaman, lekin ayniqsa elektron va alternativ rokka qiziqaman. Elektron musiqani juda rag'batlantiruvchi deb bilaman va bu diqqatni jamlashim kerak bo'lganda juda mos keladi. Alternativ rok esa, ko'pincha men qadrlaydigan murakkab lirik mavzularga ega. Garchi ba'zan boshqa janrlardan ham zavqlansam-da, bu ikkitasi ko'p hollarda mening asosiy tanlovimdir. O'ylaymanki, xilma-xil musiqiy didga ega bo'lish muhim, lekin doimiy ravishda qaytib boradigan janrlarga ega bo'lish ham yaxshi.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - What kind of music do you like to listen to?
sentenceStarters: "I absolutely love listening to..." - "Men ... ni tinglashni juda yaxshi ko'raman..."
"My favorite genre of music is..." - "Mening sevimli musiqa janrim..."
"What I enjoy most about this music is..." - "Bu musiqada eng yoqadigan narsa..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
I absolutely love listening to pop and indie music! These genres have a special place in my heart because of their catchy melodies and meaningful lyrics.
Pop music is great for lifting my mood when I'm feeling down, while indie music helps me relax and unwind after a long day. I find that music is a powerful way to express emotions and connect with others who share similar tastes.
As the saying goes, "Music is the universal language of mankind." I genuinely believe that the right song can transform your mood and make any moment more memorable.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men pop va indie musiqalarini tinglashni juda yaxshi ko'raman! Ushbu janrlar o'zining yoqimli ohanglari va mazmunli matnlari tufayli mening qalbimda alohida o'ringa ega.

Pop musiqa kayfiyatim tushkun bo'lganida uni ko'tarish uchun juda yaxshi, indie musiqa esa uzoq kundan keyin dam olishimga yordam beradi. Musiqa his-tuyg'ularni ifodalash va o'xshash didlarga ega bo'lgan boshqalar bilan bog'lanishning kuchli usuli ekanligini angladim.

Aytishlaricha, "Musiqa - insoniyatning universal tilidir". Men chin dildan ishonamanki, to'g'ri qo'shiq kayfiyatingizni o'zgartirishi va har qanday lahzani yanada unutilmas qilishi mumkin.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer shopping online or in stores?
questions.sampleA1: I like shop online. It is easy. I buy shoes.
questions.sampleA2: I like shopping online. It's easy and fast. But sometimes I go to the store because I want to see the things. I like clothes from the store.
questions.sampleB1: I prefer shopping online. I think it's more convenient because I can do it from home. Also, it saves time because I don't have to go to the store. However, sometimes I like to go to the store to see things in person before I buy them.
questions.sampleB2: I'm definitely more of an online shopper, to be honest. It just saves so much hassle — I can browse through loads of options and compare prices without leaving the sofa. That said, when it comes to clothes, I still like to pop into a shop and try things on, because you never really know how something fits until you do.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men internetda xarid qilishni yoqtiraman. Bu oson. Men oyoq kiyim sotib olaman.
questions.uzSampleA2: Men internetda xarid qilishni yoqtiraman. Bu oson va tez. Lekin ba'zida do'konga boraman, chunki narsalarni ko'rishni xohlayman. Menga do'kondagi kiyimlar yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men internetda xarid qilishni afzal ko'raman. Menimcha, bu qulayroq, chunki men buni uyimdan turib qila olaman. Bundan tashqari, vaqtni tejaydi, chunki do'konga borishim shart emas.
Lekin, ba'zida men narsalarni sotib olishdan oldin ularni shaxsan ko'rish uchun do'konga borishni xohlayman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Men odatda qulayligi va samaradorligi tufayli onlayn xarid qilishni afzal ko'raman. Bu menga turli chakana sotuvchilarning narxlarini tezda solishtirish va mahalliy do'konlarda topishim mumkin bo'lganidan ko'ra kengroq assortimentdagi mahsulotlarga kirish imkonini beradi. Biroq, men hali ham jismoniy do'konlarda xarid qilish tajribasini qadrlayman, ayniqsa kiyim yoki mebel kabi narsalarni sotib olayotganda, ularning sifatini va mosligini bevosita baholash imkoniyatini qadrlayman.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Do you prefer shopping online or in stores?
sentenceStarters: "I prefer shopping online because..." - "Men onlayn xarid qilishni afzal ko'raman, chunki..."
"The advantage of online shopping is..." - "Onlayn xarid qilishning afzalligi..."
"When it comes to shopping, I tend to..." - "Xarid qilish haqida gap ketganda, men odatda..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Honestly, I prefer shopping online most of the time. It's incredibly convenient and saves a lot of time and energy.
With online shopping, I can browse through thousands of products from the comfort of my home, compare prices easily, and read reviews from other customers. The items are delivered directly to my doorstep, which is a huge advantage.
However, for certain things like clothes or shoes, I still prefer going to physical stores so I can try them on before buying. As they say, "The best of both worlds" – I use both methods depending on what I need to buy!
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men ko'pincha onlayn xarid qilishni afzal ko'raman. Bu juda qulay va ko'p vaqt va energiyani tejaydi.

Onlayn xarid qilish orqali men uyimdan chiqmasdan minglab mahsulotlarni ko'rib chiqishim, narxlarni osongina solishtirishim va boshqa xaridorlarning fikrlarini o'qishim mumkin. Buyumlar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri uyimga yetkazib beriladi, bu juda katta afzallik.

Ammo, kiyim yoki poyabzal kabi narsalar uchun, men hali ham do'konga borib, sotib olishdan oldin ularni kiyib ko'rishni afzal ko'raman. Aytishlaricha, "ikki dunyoning eng yaxshisi" – men nima sotib olishim kerakligiga qarab, ikkala usuldan ham foydalanaman!

questions.prompt: How many hours of sleep do you usually get?
questions.sampleA2:
I sleep seven hours.

I go to bed late and I wake up early.

I like to sleep more, but I can't.
questions.sampleB1:
I usually sleep about six or seven hours.

Sometimes I sleep more on the weekend.

I think it's important to get enough sleep, but it's difficult sometimes because I have a lot of work.

For example, last night I only slept for five hours.
questions.sampleB2: On a good night, I manage around seven hours, though I'll admit I don't always stick to it. During the week I tend to stay up far too late, so I end up running on empty by Friday. I suppose I catch up on sleep at the weekend, but honestly, I know I should be more disciplined about it.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men yetti soat uxlayman.

Men kech yotaman va erta turaman.

Men ko'proq uxlashni xohlayman, lekin ilojim yo'q.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men odatda olti yoki yetti soat uxlayman.

Ba'zan dam olish kunlarida ko'proq uxlayman.

Menimcha, yetarli uxlash muhim, lekin ba'zan qiyin, chunki ishim ko'p.

Masalan, o'tgan kecha men faqat besh soat uxladim.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Odatda, men yetti soat atrofida uxlay olaman, garchi bu mening ish yukim va ijtimoiy majburiyatlarimga qarab o'zgarib tursa ham.

Ideal holda, men sakkiz soat uxlashni afzal ko'rardim, chunki bu mening kognitiv funksiyamni va umumiy farovonligimni sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi.

Biroq, muddatlar yoki kechki tadbirlar bilan yuzma-yuz kelganda, uyquga ustunlik berish ko'pincha qiyin bo'ladi.

Men uzoq muddatli foyda olish uchun uyqu rejimimga nisbatan ko'proq intizomli bo'lishga harakat qilyapman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - How many hours of sleep do you usually get?
sentenceStarters: "On average, I get about..." - "O'rtacha men taxminan ... olaman..."
"I usually go to bed at..." - "Men odatda ... da uxlayman..."
"My sleep schedule tends to be..." - "Mening uyqu rejimim odatda..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
On average, I get about seven hours of sleep per night, although I wish I could get more! During weekdays, I typically go to bed around midnight and wake up at seven.
I've noticed that when I get sufficient sleep, I'm much more productive and have better concentration throughout the day. Unfortunately, busy schedules and screen time often cut into my sleep hours.
As the saying goes, "Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy, and wise." I'm definitely trying to improve my sleep habits and establish a better routine!
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Oʻrtacha hisobda, men har kecha taxminan yetti soat uxlayman, garchi koʻproq uxlashni xohlayman! Ish kunlari odatda yarim tunda yotib, soat yettida uygʻonaman.

Shuni payqadimki, yetarli uxlashga erishganimda, kun davomida ancha unumliroq boʻlaman va diqqatim yaxshiroq jamlanadi. Afsuski, band jadval va ekran vaqti koʻpincha uyqu soatlarimni qisqartiradi.

Maqolda aytilganidek, "Erta yotib, erta turgan odam sogʻlom, boy va dono boʻladi." Men, albatta, uyqu odatlarimni yaxshilashga va yaxshiroq tartib oʻrnatishga harakat qilyapman!

questions.prompt: Compare these two pictures showing different ways people spend their free time.
questions.sampleA1: Picture one, people happy. Music. Picture two, book. I like music.
questions.sampleA2: In the first picture, people are listening to music and dancing. It looks fun. But in the second picture, a person is reading a book. It's quiet. I like to read and I like music, but I prefer music.
questions.sampleB1: The first picture shows people at a concert, and they seem to be having a good time. It looks very exciting and social. The second picture shows someone reading a book. It looks more relaxing and peaceful. I think both activities are good ways to spend free time, however, I prefer the concert because I enjoy being with other people and listening to music.
questions.sampleB2: These two pictures couldn't be more different in terms of atmosphere and activity. The first image shows us a vibrant indoor concert or live event, with a large crowd and many hands raised. The stage is illuminated by a striking display of spotlights, creating a very energetic and exciting mood. In stark contrast, the second picture depicts a much quieter scene. A young woman is sitting on the floor in a library aisle, deeply engrossed in a book, surrounded by shelves. She appears completely focused on her reading. While the first image suggests a communal, high-energy experience, the second highlights a solitary and reflective pastime.
questions.uzSampleA1: Birinchi rasmda odamlar xursand. Musiqa. Ikkinchi rasmda, kitob. Menga musiqa yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Birinchi rasmda odamlar musiqa tinglashmoqda va raqsga tushishmoqda. Qiziqarli ko'rinadi.
Lekin ikkinchi rasmda bir odam kitob o'qiyapti. Jim. Men o'qishni ham, musiqani ham yaxshi ko'raman, lekin musiqa menga ko'proq yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Birinchi rasmda odamlar konsertda ekanligi ko'rinib turibdi va ular yaxshi vaqt o'tkazayotganga o'xshaydi. Bu juda hayajonli va ijtimoiy ko'rinadi. Ikkinchi rasmda esa kimdir kitob o'qiyapti. Bu ko'proq dam oluvchi va tinch ko'rinadi. Menimcha, ikkala mashg'ulot ham bo'sh vaqtni o'tkazish uchun yaxshi usullar,
lekin men konsertni afzal ko'raman, chunki men boshqa odamlar bilan birga bo'lishni va musiqa tinglashni yoqtiraman.
questions.uzSampleB2: Bu rasmlar bo'sh vaqtni o'tkazishning qarama-qarshi usullarini taqdim etadi. Birinchisi, jonli konsert muhitini aks ettiradi, bu esa ijtimoiy muloqot va energetik stimulyatsiyaga bo'lgan ehtiyojni ko'rsatadi. Bu umumiy tajriba va jamoaviy zavq hissini taqdim etadigan faoliyat turiga o'xshaydi. Boshqa tomondan, ikkinchi rasmda kitob o'qiyotgan odam ko'rsatilgan, bu esa bo'sh vaqtga nisbatan yolg'izlik va mulohazali yondashuvni anglatadi. Bu dam olish va ehtimol, kitob o'qish orqali shaxsiy o'sishga bo'lgan istakni ko'rsatadi. Ikkala usul ham dam olishning maqbul yo'li bo'lsa-da, tanlov shaxsning individual xususiyatlariga va hozirgi kayfiyatiga bog'liq bo'lishi mumkin. Shaxsan men konsertga ko'proq moyilman, chunki jonli musiqaning energiyasi meni tetiklashtiradi.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Compare these two pictures...
idioms: "Different strokes for different folks" - "Har kimning o'z didi bor"
sentenceStarters: "The first picture shows..." - "Birinchi rasm ... ni ko'rsatmoqda..."
"In contrast, the second image depicts..." - "Aksincha, ikkinchi rasm ... ni tasvirlamoqda..."
"The main difference between them is..." - "Ular orasidagi asosiy farq..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
These two pictures show distinctly different ways of spending leisure time, and each has its own unique appeal.
The first image depicts live entertainment – people enjoying a concert or performance. This type of activity is all about energy, excitement, and shared experiences. The atmosphere is typically vibrant and electric, with people coming together to enjoy music and celebrate.
The second picture shows a quieter activity – someone engaged in a more peaceful, solitary pursuit. This represents a calmer approach to leisure, focused on relaxation, reflection, or personal enrichment. It's a more introspective way of spending time.
The contrast is striking. Live entertainment offers social connection and adrenaline, while quiet activities provide peace and mental restoration. As they say, "Different strokes for different folks." Both are valuable – sometimes we need excitement, and other times we need tranquility to recharge our batteries.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu ikki rasm dam olish vaqtini o'tkazishning tubdan farq qiluvchi usullarini ko'rsatadi va ularning har biri o'ziga xos jozibaga ega.

Birinchi rasmda jonli ko'ngilochar tadbir – odamlar konsert yoki spektakldan zavqlanishmoqda. Bunday turdagi faoliyat butunlay energiya, hayajon va umumiy tajribalar haqida. Atmosfera odatda jonli va elektrga to'la bo'lib, odamlar musiqa tinglash va bayram qilish uchun birga yig'ilishadi.

Ikkinchi rasmda esa ancha tinchroq faoliyat – kimdir osoyishta, yakka tartibdagi mashg'ulot bilan band. Bu dam olishga nisbatan xotirjam yondashuvni ifodalaydi, u dam olish, mulohaza qilish yoki shaxsiy boyishga qaratilgan. Bu vaqtni o'tkazishning yanada ichki dunyoga yo'naltirilgan usuli.

Farq juda sezilarli. Jonli ko'ngilochar tadbirlar ijtimoiy aloqa va adrenalinni taklif qilsa, tinch faoliyat esa xotirjamlik va ruhiy tiklanishni ta'minlaydi. Aytishlaricha, "Har kimning o'z didi bor". Ikkalasi ham qimmatli – ba'zida bizga hayajon kerak bo'lsa, ba'zida esa kuchimizni tiklash uchun xotirjamlik kerak bo'ladi.

questions.prompt: Why do some people prefer live entertainment?
questions.sampleA1: I like music. Live music is good. I see band. It is fun.
questions.sampleA2: Some people like live music. I like it too. It is different than TV. Because it is real. And I can see the people.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people prefer live entertainment because it's more exciting. For example, going to a concert is different than listening to the music at home. You can see the artist in person, and the atmosphere is better. However, it can also be more expensive.
questions.sampleB2: I think the main draw is the atmosphere, honestly. When you're there in person, there's an energy in the crowd that you simply can't get across through a screen. The thing is, live shows are unpredictable — anything could happen — and being surrounded by people who share your excitement creates a real sense of belonging. It's an experience that stays with you.
questions.uzSampleA1: Menga musiqa yoqadi. Jonli musiqa yaxshi. Men guruhni ko'raman. Bu qiziqarli.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ba'zi odamlar jonli musiqani yoqtirishadi. Men ham uni yoqtiraman. U televizordan farq qiladi. Chunki u haqiqiy. Va men odamlarni ko'ra olaman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar jonli tomoshalarni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki u yanada hayajonliroq.
Masalan, konsertga borish uyda musiqa tinglashdan farq qiladi. Siz artistni shaxsan ko'rishingiz mumkin va atmosfera yaxshiroq bo'ladi.
Biroq, bu qimmatroq ham bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Menimcha, jonli ko'ngilochar o'yinlar yozib olingan medialar taklif qila olmaydigan o'ziga xos jozibaga ega. Birinchidan, spektaklda jismonan hozir bo'lganingizda his qiladigan noyob atmosfera mavjud. Sizni undan zavqlanayotgan boshqa odamlar o'rab oladi, bu esa umumiy tajriba hissini yaratadi. Bundan tashqari, jonli ijrolar ko'pincha o'z-o'zidan va oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan bo'ladi, bu ularni oldindan yozib olingan narsalardan ko'ra yodda qolarli qiladi. Nima bo'lishini hech qachon aniq bilmaysiz.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - Why do some people prefer live entertainment?
idioms: "The show must go on" - "Shou davom etishi kerak"
sentenceStarters: "Live entertainment appeals to people because..." - "Jonli ko'ngilochar tadbirlar odamlarga yoqadi, chunki..."
"The main attraction of live events is..." - "Jonli tadbirlarning asosiy jozibasi..."
"People are drawn to live entertainment for..." - "Odamlar jonli ko'ngil ochishlarga ... uchun jalb qilinadi..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Live entertainment has a uniquely powerful appeal that recorded or digital experiences simply cannot replicate. There are several reasons why people are drawn to it.
Firstly, live events create an electric atmosphere that's impossible to experience at home. Being in a crowd of people who share your passion, all reacting together to the same performance, creates a sense of community and belonging. The energy is contagious!
Secondly, live entertainment is unpredictable and genuinely exciting. Every performance is unique – artists might improvise, interact with the audience, or do something unexpected. This spontaneity makes each experience one-of-a-kind.
Additionally, attending live events creates lasting memories. People often remember concerts or shows they attended years ago because they were emotionally impactful. As the saying goes, "Life is about creating memories." Live entertainment certainly delivers on that!
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Jonli ko'ngilochar tadbirlar yozib olingan yoki raqamli tajribalar oddiygina takrorlay olmaydigan o'ziga xos kuchli jozibaga ega. Odamlarning unga intilishining bir nechta sabablari bor.

Birinchidan, jonli tadbirlar uyda his qilishning iloji bo'lmagan hayajonli muhit yaratadi. Sizning ishtiyoqingizni baham ko'radigan, bir xil ijroga birgalikda munosabat bildiradigan odamlar olomonida bo'lish, hamjamiyat va mansublik hissini yaratadi. Energiya yuqumli!

Ikkinchidan, jonli ko'ngilochar tadbirlar oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan va chinakam hayajonli. Har bir chiqish noyobdir - rassomlar improvizatsiya qilishlari, tomoshabinlar bilan muloqot qilishlari yoki kutilmagan narsalarni qilishlari mumkin. Bu o'z-o'zidan paydo bo'lish har bir tajribani betakror qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, jonli tadbirlarga tashrif buyurish uzoq muddatli xotiralarni yaratadi. Odamlar ko'pincha yillar oldin tashrif buyurgan konsertlari yoki shoulari haqida eslashadi, chunki ular hissiy jihatdan ta'sirli edi. Aytishlaricha, "Hayot - bu xotiralar yaratish demakdir". Jonli ko'ngilochar tadbirlar, albatta, buni ta'minlaydi!

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of quiet leisure activities?
questions.sampleA1: I like to read. It is quiet. It is good.
questions.sampleA2: I like quiet things. I like to read books and listen to music. It is relaxing. And it is good because I am not stressed.
questions.sampleB1: I think quiet activities are good. For example, reading or listening to music. They help you relax after a long day. Also, you can learn new things from reading. However, some people prefer more active things.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, quiet activities are exactly what you need to unwind after a hectic day. Something like reading or gardening lets you switch off and gives your mind a proper rest. I suppose the biggest benefit is that they help you recharge your batteries and clear your head, which makes you far more focused when you get back to work.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman. U tinch. U yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga tinch narsalar yoqadi. Kitob o'qishni va musiqa tinglashni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu dam beradi. Va bu yaxshi, chunki men stressda emasman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
O'ylaymanki, sokin mashg'ulotlar yaxshi.
Masalan, kitob o'qish yoki musiqa tinglash. Ular uzoq kundan keyin dam olishga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, kitob o'qish orqali yangi narsalarni o'rganishingiz mumkin.
Biroq, ba'zi odamlar ko'proq faol narsalarni afzal ko'rishadi.
questions.uzSampleB2: Sokin dam olish mashg'ulotlarining bir nechta afzalliklari bor. Asosiy foydalaridan biri bu stressni kamaytirish; kitob o'qish yoki bog'dorchilik kabi mashg'ulotlar juda tinchlantiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu mashg'ulotlar, shuningdek, o'z-o'zini tahlil qilish imkoniyatini ham beradi. Doimiy tashqi stimulyatsiya o'rniga, o'ylash va fikrlaringizni qayta ishlash uchun vaqtingiz bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, musiqa asbobini o'rganish yoki rasm chizish kabi ko'plab sokin hobbiylar ijodkorlikni oshirishi va muvaffaqiyat hissini ta'minlashi mumkin.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - What are the benefits of quiet leisure activities?
sentenceStarters: "Quiet activities are beneficial because..." - "Tinch mashg'ulotlar foydali, chunki..."
"The main advantage of quiet leisure is..." - "Tinch dam olishning asosiy afzalligi..."
"People enjoy quiet activities for..." - "Odamlar tinch mashg'ulotlardan ... uchun zavqlanishadi..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Quiet leisure activities offer numerous benefits that are especially valuable in our fast-paced modern world.
Firstly, they provide an opportunity for mental restoration. Activities like reading, meditation, or simply sitting in nature allow our minds to rest and recover from the constant stimulation of daily life. This is essential for maintaining good mental health and preventing burnout.
Secondly, quiet activities encourage self-reflection and personal growth. When we're not surrounded by noise and distractions, we can think more deeply about our lives, goals, and feelings. This introspection is incredibly valuable for self-improvement.
Furthermore, many quiet activities like reading or learning new skills contribute to our intellectual development. They expand our knowledge and keep our minds sharp. As the saying goes, "Silence is golden." Sometimes the most productive moments come from quiet contemplation rather than constant activity.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Tinch dam olish mashg'ulotlari, ayniqsa, bizning tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan zamonaviy dunyomizda juda qimmatli bo'lgan ko'plab afzalliklarni taqdim etadi.

Birinchidan, ular aqliy tiklanish uchun imkoniyat yaratadi. O'qish, meditatsiya yoki shunchaki tabiatda o'tirish kabi mashg'ulotlar bizning ongimizga dam berishga va kundalik hayotning doimiy stimulyatsiyasidan tiklanishga imkon beradi. Bu yaxshi ruhiy salomatlikni saqlash va charchoqning oldini olish uchun zarurdir.

Ikkinchidan, tinch mashg'ulotlar o'z-o'zini tahlil qilish va shaxsiy o'sishni rag'batlantiradi. Biz shovqin va chalg'ituvchi omillar bilan o'ralmagan bo'lsak, hayotimiz, maqsadlarimiz va his-tuyg'ularimiz haqida chuqurroq o'ylashimiz mumkin. Bu ichki kuzatuv o'z-o'zini takomillashtirish uchun juda qimmatlidir.

Bundan tashqari, o'qish yoki yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganish kabi ko'plab tinch mashg'ulotlar bizning intellektual rivojlanishimizga hissa qo'shadi. Ular bizning bilimimizni kengaytiradi va ongimizni o'tkir saqlaydi. Aytishlaricha, "Sukut - oltin". Ba'zan eng samarali daqiqalar doimiy faoliyatdan ko'ra tinch mulohazadan kelib chiqadi.

questions.sampleA1: I like my toys. I have a car. It is red. I play with my friends.
questions.sampleA2: I remember my birthday party. It was fun. I had cake and presents. I played games with my friends and we laughed a lot. It was a good day because I was happy.
questions.sampleB1: I remember when I learned to ride my bike. It was hard at first, and I fell down a few times. But I kept trying, and eventually, I could do it. I felt really proud of myself. I think it's important to remember things like that, because it shows you can achieve things if you don't give up.
questions.sampleB2: One childhood memory that really stands out for me is the summers I spent at my grandparents' place out in the countryside. To be honest, those were some of the happiest days of my life. Every morning my cousins and I would head off to the river, spend hours splashing about, and only come back home when we were absolutely starving, our clothes soaked through and grins all over our faces. In the evenings, my grandmother would tell us these long, winding folk tales, and I'd drift off to sleep feeling completely content. The thing is, there were no phones and no schedules — just pure, simple fun. As for whether childhood is the happiest time of life, I'd say it certainly can be, though I wouldn't want to generalise too much. Children are largely free from the responsibilities that weigh us down as adults — bills, work, that sort of thing. On the other hand, I suppose happiness really boils down to your mindset, and plenty of people are far happier later in life once they've found their feet. I think people look back on their childhood so fondly mainly because of nostalgia. Our memories have a funny way of filtering out the bad bits and holding onto the golden moments. When life gets stressful, we naturally hark back to a time when everything felt simpler and safer. It's almost like our minds paint the past in a warmer light than it really was. At the end of the day, those early years shape who we become, so it's no wonder they hold such a special place in our hearts.

O'zimdan juda faxrlangandim. O'ylashimcha, shunga o'xshash narsalarni eslab yurish muhim, chunki bu siz taslim bo'lmasangiz, nimalarga erisha olishingizni ko'rsatadi.

Biz haftalar davomida rejalashtirdik, materiallar to'pladik va birgalikda ishladik. bulletPoints: Describe a happy memory from your childhood
Do you think childhood is the happiest time of life?
Why do people often remember their childhood fondly?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One of my fondest childhood memories is spending summers at my grandparents' village. Every year, my family would travel there, and those weeks were absolutely magical.
I remember running through fields, playing with cousins until sunset, and listening to my grandmother's stories at night. The simplicity of those days – no phones, no internet, just pure enjoyment of nature and family – left a lasting impression on me.
As for whether childhood is the happiest time, I believe it certainly can be for many people. Children have fewer responsibilities and worries. They experience the world with wonder and curiosity. However, happiness can be found at any age – it depends on one's perspective.
People remember childhood fondly because of nostalgia – we tend to remember the good times more vividly than the bad. As the saying goes, "Those were the days." Our minds naturally filter out negative experiences and preserve the golden moments of our early years.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Mening eng yoqimli bolalik xotiralarimdan biri bu yozni buvim va buvamning qishlog'ida o'tkazishdir. Har yili oilam bilan u yerga borardik va o'sha haftalar mutlaqo sehrli edi.

Esimda, dalalarda yugurardim, quyosh botguncha amakivachchalarim bilan o'ynardim va kechasi buvimning hikoyalarini tinglardim. O'sha kunlarning soddaligi – telefonlar yo'q, internet yo'q, faqat tabiat va oiladan sof zavq olish – menda uzoq muddatli taassurot qoldirdi.

Bolalik eng baxtli davrmi, degan savolga kelsak, menimcha, bu ko'p odamlar uchun albatta shunday bo'lishi mumkin. Bolalarning mas'uliyati va tashvishlari kamroq. Ular dunyoni hayrat va qiziquvchanlik bilan his qilishadi. Biroq, baxtni har qanday yoshda topish mumkin – bu odamning nuqtai nazariga bog'liq.

Odamlar bolalikni sog'inch bilan eslashadi, chunki biz yaxshi kunlarni yomon kunlarga qaraganda yorqinroq eslashga moyilmiz. Aytishlaricha, "O'sha kunlar edi". Ongimiz tabiiy ravishda salbiy tajribalarni filtrlashadi va ilk yillarimizning oltin lahzalarini saqlab qoladi.

questions.prompt: Social Media Does More Harm Than Good
questions.sampleA1: Social media... I like. But bad things too. People sad. I like photos.
questions.sampleA2: I use social media. It's fun to see friends. But sometimes people are mean. And I spend too much time on it. I think it's okay, but not all good.
questions.sampleB1: I think social media has good and bad sides. For example, it's good to connect with friends and family who live far away. However, sometimes people post things that aren't true, and that's bad. Also, I think some people spend too much time online and not enough time doing other things. So, it's a bit of both, I think.
questions.sampleB2: This is a real double-edged sword, and I can genuinely see both sides of the argument. On the one hand, there's no denying that social media has brought people closer together. It lets us keep in touch with friends and family scattered across the globe, and it's given ordinary people a platform to speak up about issues that matter. For businesses, too, it's been a game-changer — small companies can now reach out to customers they'd never have found otherwise, which has honestly opened doors for a whole generation of entrepreneurs. Having said that, the drawbacks are hard to ignore. For one thing, these platforms are deliberately designed to be addictive, so people end up wasting hours mindlessly scrolling. On top of that, the constant stream of carefully curated posts can really chip away at your self-esteem, because you're forever comparing your life to everyone else's highlight reel. And of course, there's the darker side — cyberbullying and the way fake news spreads like wildfire, doing real damage before anyone can set the record straight. At the end of the day, where do I stand? I'd say I lean slightly towards the view that the harm outweighs the good, but only because we haven't learnt to use it sensibly yet. The technology itself isn't the enemy — it really comes down to how we choose to use it. If people could just cut back on their screen time and take what they see with a pinch of salt, I honestly think the balance could easily tip the other way.

Bundan tashqari, noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarning tarqalishi va kiberbullingning keng tarqalishi jiddiy tashvishlardir. Oxir oqibat, men ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ba'zi afzalliklarni taqdim etsa-da, uning ruhiy salomatlikka va umuman jamiyatga salbiy ta'siri ko'pincha ijobiy tomonlardan ustun keladi, deb hisoblayman.

questions.sampleAnswer:
The statement "Social Media Does More Harm Than Good" is a highly debated topic in our digital age. Let me explore both perspectives.
Those who agree with this statement make several valid points. Firstly, social media can be extremely addictive, causing people to waste hours scrolling instead of being productive or spending quality time with family. Secondly, platforms have become breeding grounds for cyberbullying, which has led to serious mental health issues, especially among young people. Additionally, the spread of misinformation and fake news on social media has caused real-world harm, from health scares to political polarization.
However, those who disagree also have compelling arguments. Social media has revolutionized how we connect – families separated by oceans can now video call daily. It has given voice to marginalized communities and helped organize important social movements. For businesses, especially small ones, social media provides free marketing tools that were previously unimaginable.
In my opinion, social media is a tool – its impact depends on how we use it. As the saying goes, "A sword is only as good as its wielder." With proper regulation and personal responsibility, the benefits can outweigh the harms. The key is finding healthy balance and being mindful of our digital habits.

"Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar yaxshilikdan ko'ra ko'proq zarar keltiradi" degan fikr bizning raqamli davrimizda juda ko'p bahs-munozaralarga sabab bo'lmoqda. Keling, har ikki nuqtai nazarni ko'rib chiqaylik.

Bu fikrga qo'shiladiganlar bir nechta asosli dalillarni keltiradilar. Birinchidan, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar juda ham o'rganib qolishga sabab bo'lishi mumkin, bu odamlarning unumli bo'lish yoki oilasi bilan sifatli vaqt o'tkazish o'rniga soatlab sahifalarni varaqlashga olib keladi. Ikkinchidan, platformalar kiberbulling uchun zamin bo'lib qoldi, bu esa jiddiy ruhiy salomatlik muammolariga, ayniqsa yoshlar orasida olib keldi. Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda noto'g'ri ma'lumot va soxta yangiliklarning tarqalishi sog'liqni saqlashdagi qo'rquvdan tortib siyosiy qutblanishgacha bo'lgan real dunyoga zarar yetkazdi.

Biroq, rozi bo'lmaganlarning ham ishonarli argumentlari bor. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bizning aloqa qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi – okeanlar bilan ajratilgan oilalar endi har kuni video qo'ng'iroq qilishlari mumkin. U chetda qolgan jamiyatlarga ovoz berdi va muhim ijtimoiy harakatlarni tashkil etishga yordam berdi. Bizneslar, ayniqsa kichik bizneslar uchun ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ilgari tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydigan bepul marketing vositalarini taqdim etadi.

Mening fikrimcha, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar bu – vosita, uning ta'siri biz undan qanday foydalanishimizga bog'liq. Aytganlaridek, "Qilich egasiga qarab qimmat". Tegishli tartibga solish va shaxsiy mas'uliyat bilan foydalari zararlaridan ustun bo'lishi mumkin. Asosiysi – sog'lom muvozanatni topish va raqamli odatlarimizga e'tiborli bo'lish.
